points.point: Target recognized $301 million and $1.3 billion of tariff refund reductions to Cost of Sales during the three and nine months ended October 31, 2026.
points.quote: During the three and nine months ended October 31, 2026, we recognized $ 301 million and $ 1.3 billion related to IEEPA tariff refunds ("tariff refunds") received during the respective periods as reductions of Cost of Sales.

points.point: Target recorded $593 million of net gains within SG&A Expenses in the first quarter of 2025 after settling credit card interchange fee litigation.
points.quote: As a result of these lump-sum settlements, during the first quarter of 2025, we recorded gains within SG&A Expenses of $ 593 million, net of legal fees.

points.point: Target recognized $46 million of impairments and other charges during the three and nine months ended November 1, 2025, due to terminating a commercial partnership.
points.quote: For the three and nine months ended November 1, 2025, we recognized $ 46 million of impairments and other charges associated with the termination of a commercial partnership.
